verdict.rationale: The Multi-Currency Pricing API lets merchants display prices and take payment in shoppers' preferred currencies with local payment methods. Funds settle like-for-like into a natively multi-currency wallet, avoiding forced conversion, and Transfers can move them to the merchant's own bank accounts. Feature availability varies by the business's registered location. missing for 10: explicit documentation of FX rate/markup transparency at conversion, a documented automatic convert-and-settle-to-home-currency bank payout flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
